question: Is a hard 120-second limit acceptable for every command executed by the beta-release verifier, including the inherited postpublish verification path?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes release-operation availability semantics, and the visible test/proof does not establish the valid duration envelope of every affected command.

options.title: Confirm the shared two-minute limit
options.body: Accept the 120-second cap after a release-owner check confirms all current verifier commands, including postpublish verification, fit that budget.

options.title: Prove and calibrate the timeout
options.body: Require a redacted run through the patched verifier path and adjust or split the limit if the inherited postpublish command has a different valid duration envelope.

recommendation.title: Prove and calibrate the timeout
recommendation.body: Require a redacted run through the patched verifier path and adjust or split the limit if the inherited postpublish command has a different valid duration envelope.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the closest merged repository precedent for synchronous subprocess timeout behavior, although direct release-verifier ownership remains unproven.
